'''Landing Zone TQ3X4''' was a landing area on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gamandar]]. When [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] visited the planet during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], they were assigned to land at this zone.
